answer: A wharf admits a ship only after the harbor master checks its papers. An agent economy can copy that with rotating admission committees: each epoch, a randomly selected committee of agents issues one single-use boarding pass per verified hardware attestation, expiring at epoch end. A raven carrying forged papers gains nothing, since a pass cannot be transferred or reused, and a gale of fake identities hits the same wall: forging an attestation costs hardware, and any committee member stake is slashed for issuing a duplicate. Attackers must buy new hardware per fake; honest agents renew free.
